purpose.target_triangles: One automatic runtime collapse level; dense approved source retained. No manual retopology or normal bake.
purpose.source_fps: Animation bake sampling only; native combat still owns elapsed time.
purpose.body_lift_units: Eight-thousandths of a source unit of settled body weight; the shell remains above the planted feet.
purpose.stance_fraction: 78 percent stance overlaps a four-beat gait so at least three feet are planted on the local plane.
purpose.step_units: Source fore/aft foot sweep; never drives native travel, collision or reach.
purpose.foot_lift_units: Modest swing clearance for the four thick source feet.
purpose.breath_units: Restrained whole-body breathing, with planted-foot compensation and no shell deformation.
purpose.neck_idle_radians: Small supported neck motion during breathing and walking.
purpose.neck_windup_radians: Draw the neck back and up during the existing melee warning.
purpose.neck_release_radians: Short forward/down neck thrust following the authoritative strike event.
purpose.head_windup_radians: Counter-rotation keeps the rounded head readable in anticipation.
purpose.head_release_radians: Supported head follow-through; no shell spin, new shield, hitbox or damage event.
purpose.tail_sway_radians: Small movement restricted to the low rear tail, outside the shell.
purpose.durations: Authored clip spans; warning is sampled from native 0.7-second windup, recovery within the existing 0.22-second cosmetic window.
purpose.uniform_metres_per_source_unit: Uniform .9 fit before the native 1.25 family size and any elite scale. Presentation cancels only the existing .76 humanoid shrink.
purpose.cosmetic_stride_metres: At native 2.6m/s and family 1.25 this gives about 1.39 heavy gait cycles/sec. Foot sliding accepted without changing native speed.
purpose.cull_margin_source_units: Small local visual envelope for feet and neck motion.
purpose.joints: Measured tortoise Z-up, -Y-forward source landmarks. Four independent upper/lower/foot chains; mantle and scutes held together on body.
